msg: Send by GroupChatOn is live. Peer-to-peer encrypted file transfer — any size, no uploads, no servers, browser to browser.
Infinity is now a static PWA. 609 tools rebuilt on GitHub Pages — faster loads, full offline support, installable as an app.
Help rebuilt on GitHub Pages. 867 articles now load faster, with full-text search and WhatsApp guides in Hindi, Punjabi, and Bhojpuri.
Toolkit expanded to 17 kits. 87 Excel & Word files covering GST, payroll, letters, agreements, restaurant, clinic, and construction.
GroupChatOn reading app launched. Installable PWA at app.groupchaton.com — offline reading, chapter sync, all novels free.
Share launched on its own domain. 2,400+ WhatsApp groups and channels, with live search, categories, and a one-tap join flow.
